question: Where is Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amritsar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) is situated in Amritsar, Punjab.
 
• The word Harmandir literally means **God’s House**.
 
• It is an important place of worship for Sikhism.
